tiers.name: Child Athlete Sponsorship
tiers.description: Supports equipment and assists 200–250 children annually who need financial help to participate.

tiers.name: Team Sponsor
tiers.description: Logo on team banner displayed at all season games. Sponsors may designate a specific team.

tiers.name: Field Sponsor
tiers.description: Recognition on Victory Park banners, season t-shirts, and newsletter. Funds field maintenance and equipment.

tiers.name: League Sponsor
tiers.description: Supports major infrastructure, such as new goals, field-painting equipment, and clubhouse improvements.
